judgements.rationale: [self_critique] Oracle fit review: each written Check was sourced from a committed acceptance criterion, and the two state-transition checks on t3 and t5 included explicit baseline-capture steps before the action that changed results.

[self_critique] Technique fit review: happy-path routing, partial-input routing, refinement, and editability stayed as separate tests because each path has a distinct observable outcome; accessibility and localization remained isolated so their assertions did not ride on broader success flows.

[self_critique] Negative-case review: I did not add unsupported invalid-input or failure tests because this source set only promised successful routing, refinement availability, keyboard access, and copy continuity; inventing rejection behavior would exceed the evidence.

[self_critique] Assert-breadth review: the map-refinement assertion is broader than ideal because the source names location-based refinement but does not define one concrete target area or control; gap g4 records the missing run data needed to tighten that observable.

[self_critique] Assert-breadth review: the filter-update assertion compares a stored visible-results signature before and after applying a filter because the source promises updated results but does not define a specific filter or expected count delta; gap g3 records the missing concrete filter data.
